figurative_meaning_en: someone who shirks or dodges work duties
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা কামচোর, অফিসে এসেও কাজ করে না।
কামচোর লোকের সঙ্গে কাজ করতে ইচ্ছে করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a work shirker; he comes to the office but doesn't do any work.
I don't like working with lazy dodgers who avoid their duties.
note: Common colloquial term in Bengali for describing lazy individuals in professional or daily settings.
